subject: Next steps: procurement path & legal -> security -> finance timeline
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@medrevenue.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@medrevenue.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: procurement path & legal -> security -> finance timeline

Hi Jordan (and Procurement team),

Thanks again for the product demo this morning — great conversation and clear fit on the latency/cost profile for your triage workflows. As promised, summarizing the procurement path we discussed and the concrete next steps so everyone is aligned.

Quick recap of the purchase options we covered:
- PO (preferred by your finance) — standard Redwood enterprise SOW + PO.
- Company credit card (faster, but may require a one-time spend approval).
- Cloud marketplace (AWS Marketplace) — we can support invoiced subscription via marketplace if you need vendor-of-record benefits.

Proposed procurement milestones & estimated durations (please confirm if these match your internal experience):
1) Legal review of SOW and terms — estimated 7-14 business days.
2) Security review / vendor questionnaire — 10-20 business days (depends on depth).
3) Finance approval + PO issuance — 3-7 business days after approvals.

Immediate asks from our side:
- Please confirm preferred payment instrument (PO vs card vs marketplace). If PO, please share: the billing contact name/email and any PO template or submission portal link.
- If you have a vendor security questionnaire, send it over and we’ll complete it this week.
- Target date for PO issuance (we'll align SOW and provisioning with that).

Next steps I will take:
- Share a draft SOW and a one-page Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones for sign-off (attached: SOW_v1.pdf, MAP_v1 placeholder).
- Karthik will stand by to answer any legal questions you surface.

Proposed MAP (high level) — we can convert to an editable spreadsheet after you confirm:
- Week 0: SOW review (Redwood sends draft) — owner: Grace / Karthik
- Week 1-2: Legal & procurement review — owner: Jordan / MedRevenue procurement
- Week 2-4: Security questionnaire & evidence exchange — owner: Marissa / Redwood Security
- Week 3-5: Finance approval and PO issuance — owner: MedRevenue Finance
- Once PO received: Redwood provisioning + kickoff — owner: Redwood Ops

If the above looks right, can you confirm timeline targets (legal/security/finance) and whether MedRevenue will route via PO or prefer card/marketplace?

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a single-sheet MAP and SOW attached for your review.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: SOW_v1.pdf (PDF, 45KB)

From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@medrevenue.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medrevenue.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement path & legal -> security -> finance timeline

Grace — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers from procurement side: we expect to move forward on a PO (our default for new vendors). A few notes below.

- Payment instrument: PO (preferred). We will not use marketplace for this initial engagement due to vendor-of-record requirements.
- Target PO issuance: our current target is week of Aug 9, 2026 (target date Aug 10) — contingent on legal/security turnaround.
- Legal review: typical internal review runs 7–10 business days for standard SaaS SOWs; if Karthik can flag any clauses that typically slow us down (data residency, indemnity, termination), that would help speed review.
- Security: I attached a short vendor questionnaire (Vendor_Security_Q_A.xlsx). Our security team expects 10–15 business days once we receive the completed questionnaire and any supporting evidence (SOC report, encryption/keys details).

I'll route the SOW to our procurement inbox (procurement@medrevenue.com) and copy finance. Procurement contact is: Paula N'Guyen <paula.nguyen@medrevenue.com>. Please include a billing contact on the SOW and a plain-language summary of what triggers invoices.

Also: one risk — finance has a monthly PO window that closes on the 25th of each month for the following month. If we miss that, PO issuance could slip ~3 weeks. So we should aim to have legal + security done before Jul 23 to make the July window; otherwise expect Aug 10 as earliest.

I'll complete/return the vendor questionnaire this week — attaching so you can see questions upfront.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director, Procurement 
MedRevenue Health
Attachment: Vendor_Security_Q_A.xlsx (XLSX, 18KB)

If that looks good, Marissa will start filling the questionnaire now and we'll get it back to you by end of day tomorrow.

Cheers,
